questions.question: Explain how some religious believers accept the theory of evolution.
questions.correctAnswer: Many Christians accept theistic evolution — the idea that God used evolution as his method of creation. The Catholic Church supports this view, teaching that evolution is the scientific mechanism and God is the ultimate cause.
